versions.changelog:
Initial release of Inventory Manager for e-commerce platforms.

- Track and sync inventory across multiple stores (Taobao, Douyin, etc.)
- Automated low stock alerts and customizable notification channels
- Supplier database management and automated purchase order generation
- Sales forecasting with multiple analytical methods
- Supports barcode/QR code, multi-store sync, and customizable stock rules
- Detailed daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reports
